newsitem.title: USA: USA Detergents unsure about Q1 profit.
newsitem.headline: USA Detergents unsure about Q1 profit.

text.p: USA Detergents Inc said on Thursday that it does not know whether it will be profitable for the first quarter and, if profitable, the extent of the profit.
It said revenues are expected to be slightly above analysts' expectations.
The company expects its first quarter results will be hurt by the previously reported rapid build up of manufacturing, sales and distribution capability which ocurred during the latter part of 1996.
Securities analysts had a consensus estimate for USA Detergents to earn $0.16 a share, according to First Call.
In last year's first quarter, USA Detergents reported earnings of $0.16 a share on sales of $34.1 million.
USA Detergents, which is still computing its first quarter results, expects to report its first quarter results on or about May 7, 1997.

"While revenues are presently anticipated to be slightly above analysts' expectations, the company does not presently know whether it will be profitable for the first quarter of fiscal 1997 and, if profitable, the extent of the profit," USA Detergents said in a statement.
